tasks.title: Change title to Chris's Calculator
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Update the app title from 'Christian's Calculator' to 'Chris's Calculator' in both the HTML page title and the visible h1 heading. 2. READ FIRST: Read /home/ubuntu/.eunomia/workspace/eunomia-mini-calculator/index.html (contains the <title> tag) and /home/ubuntu/.eunomia/workspace/eunomia-mini-calculator/src/App.tsx (contains the h1 heading). 3. FILES: Modify index.html and src/App.tsx — replace all occurrences of "Christian's Calculator" with "Chris's Calculator". 4. APPROACH: Simple text replacement in two files. No logic changes needed. 5. PATTERNS: This is the same change pattern as the previous 'Change title to Christian's Calculator' task.
acceptance_criteria: No occurrences of "Christian's Calculator" remain in index.html or src/App.tsx
